services.desc: This Lamp is in stock and ready to ship! Only one left until the new year when a new batch of this special glaze is mixed up. This little lamp will turn heads and liven up any space you choose for it. Glazed porcelain lamp base with vibrant blue lampshade. Cobalt cloth covered cord-8 feet of length with a clear switch 16 inches from lamp base and a white 2-prong plug. Interior use only, max 60W type A bulb. One LED lightbulb is included with purchase. Lamp height including shade is 13 inches and lamp width is 11
